facts.name: Erin C. Munz
facts.role: Clerk of Circuit Court and Comptroller
facts.assignment: Sumter County Clerk of Court and Comptroller; circuit and county court clerk services.

contact.contact_note: Fax3525696623 is Administration/Marriage, not civil intake. Civil fax separately labeled. Contact page directs division-specific PO boxes; footer directs mail through main street address. No personal clerk email established.

filing.summary: Official e-filing page links statewide portal. County civil filers prepare their papers; clerk does not prepare them. Small-claims statement signed outside clerk office requires notarization, or may be signed before deputy clerk; attachments require file and defendant copies.

records_access.summary: Official records page links CiviTek court-record search and MyFloridaCounty official-record search separately. No private case-record retrieval performed.

communications.summary: Reception phone/contact form; use division attention line for correspondence. Separate civil and official-record fax routes retained; no assertion fax constitutes filing.

small_claims_operations.summary: Clerk page directs written settlement notice before hearing. Judge Senn separately requires her office scheduling/cancellation and case-list procedures; preserve assigned judge instructions.

facts.summary: Clerk identity, main and mailing addresses, labeled fax routes and civil intake/records links verified; inconsistent hours/address/threshold wording recorded.

review_scope.collected: Nine original official HTML pages with extracted text, acquisition hashes and link inventories.
review_scope.content_reviewed: Identity/contact fields, civil filing routes and basic small-claims intake, records-search targets; conflicting hours/address/threshold statements.
review_scope.not_reviewed: Fee-table legal correctness, case-specific venue/claims advice, foreclosure merits or records of individual cases. E-filing AO link retained without treating link alone as full review.

conflicts.subject: Opening time
statements: Contact body and office blocks:8:30AM to5PM.
conflicts.disposition: Both retained; no controlling schedule chosen.

conflicts.subject: Mailing destination
statements: Contact body directs Courts/Official Records to POBox2587 and Finance/Administration to POBox247.
Footer says all mail/correspondence through Main Office street address.
conflicts.disposition: Each labeled route preserved without resolving discrepancy.

conflicts.subject: Civil dollar threshold wording
statements: Civil landing page says circuit exceeds$50,000 and county less than$50,000.
Circuit detail says$50,000 and above; county detail says$8,000.01 to$50,000.
conflicts.disposition: Source inconsistency recorded; these statements are not adopted as legal jurisdiction guidance.

gaps: Personal clerk email, named assistant and assistant-specific contacts not established on reviewed official contact/identity pages; public form and office phone retained.
